The sticky-note save path runs from the chart's note modal through `openmrsFetch` to the REST `obs` endpoint, then through `ObsService` and the Hibernate DAO.

1. **Frontend trigger:** `StickyNoteModal` submits the note. It calls `updateStickyNote` when an existing note is being edited, otherwise `createStickyNote` (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-notes-app/src/sticky-notes/sticky-note.modal.tsx:40`, `:42`).
2. **Frontend request function:** `createStickyNote` posts the obs to `${restBaseUrl}/obs` with `openmrsFetch` (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-notes-app/src/sticky-notes/sticky-note.resource.ts:57-68`).
3. **REST handler:** the `/obs` POST is served by `ObsResource1_8`, a `DataDelegatingCrudResource<Obs>`. Its `save(Obs)` calls `Context.getObsService().saveObs(delegate, "REST web service")`, then re-reads the saved obs (`openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_8/ObsResource1_8.java:267-271`). I did not read the framework's base `create` that dispatches to `save`; that step is inferred.
4. **Core service:** `ObsServiceImpl.saveObs(Obs, String)` checks privileges and, for a new obs, calls `saveNewOrVoidedObs` (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/ObsServiceImpl.java:104-127`, `:224-229`).
5. **Data access:** `saveNewOrVoidedObs` calls `dao.saveObs(obs)`. `HibernateObsDAO.saveObs` persists through `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate` on the current session (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateObsDAO.java:94-110`). The interface declaration is `ObsDAO.saveObs` (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/ObsDAO.java:36`).

Updates take a different path: `updateStickyNote` puts to `/obs/{uuid}`, which goes through `saveObs` and, for a changed existing obs, `saveExistingObs`, which inserts a new row and voids the old one. I did not trace the REST update handler beyond `save`.

Other files in the chart that matter: the note-loading hook `useStickyNote` (`sticky-note.resource.ts:31-45`) and the modal itself (`sticky-note.modal.tsx`). These are not on the write path, so I left them out of the list below.
